_meta.description: Quantitative claims of the manuscript, kept SEPARATE from generated results. scripts/reporting/check_manuscript_results.py compares them with values regenerated from RTL simulation, Vivado reports and TVLA data. Never edit a value here to make a check pass; report the discrepancy instead.
_meta.manuscript: Constant-Time BRAM-Free Single-PE NTT-based Polynomial Multiplier for CRYSTALS-Kyber on FPGA (draft of 2026-10-01)
_meta.tolerance_policy: tolerance 0 = exact equality (integers, booleans). Otherwise an absolute tolerance that covers the rounding the manuscript applies (half a unit of the last printed digit, or the rounding of intermediates the manuscript used). Checks marked tool_sensitive downgrade FAIL to WARN when the detected Vivado release differs from 2024.2.
_meta.severity_policy: default FAIL; severity=warn marks claims whose discrepancy must be resolved by the authors (reported, but the numbers they are compared with are regenerated, not edited)
